purpose: Predeclare what the existing linked field channels would look like under competing propagation, assurance-buffering and network/service-allocation explanations before any real Issue #91 field outcome is inspected.

existing_estimands_only.effective_service: observed visit bouts per monitored flower-hour multiplied by background-adjusted mean single-visit conspecific pollen deposition for the same visitor group and population
existing_estimands_only.autonomous_ratio: bagged_autonomous capsule set / supplemental_outcross capsule set
existing_estimands_only.open_ratio: open_pollinated capsule set / supplemental_outcross capsule set
existing_estimands_only.direct_dependency_target: direct_reproductive_dependency_0_1 from the existing field/reliability contract
existing_estimands_only.functional_exposure: strict abundance-weighted Rao-Q FDQ of pollinator proboscis length at population x field_event x island x site when taxon and trait coverage gates pass

predeclared_candidate_models.question: Does lower effective pollen service propagate to lower open reproductive performance more strongly where plant reproductive dependency is high?
expected_signature: effective service and open_ratio change in the same direction across admissible comparison units
the service-to-open_ratio association is stronger in higher-dependency units than in lower-dependency units
visit rate alone may disagree with effective service when visitor groups differ in SVD
predeclared_candidate_models.would_be_weakened_by: repeated low-service units with maintained open_ratio across high direct dependency after structural and precision gates pass

predeclared_candidate_models.question: When effective service is low, is maintained open reproduction associated with high autonomous reproductive assurance?
expected_signature: low effective service can coexist with maintained open_ratio
buffered units have higher autonomous_ratio and lower direct dependency than service-limited units
supplemental_outcross remains necessary as the denominator control so low open fruit set is not confused with resource or ovule limitation
predeclared_candidate_models.would_be_weakened_by: maintained open_ratio under low service when autonomous_ratio is also low, which would require a non-assurance buffer or an unmeasured mechanism

predeclared_candidate_models.question: Do visitor identity and per-visit pollen effectiveness reallocate realized service beyond what visitation frequency or functional exposure alone implies?
expected_signature: visitor groups differ in background-adjusted SVD
rate-weighted effective service can differ between units with similar visit rates
FDQ or visitor richness can remain similar while effective service differs because realized visitor composition and per-visit effectiveness differ
distinguishing_measurements: FDQ when strict trait gate passes
predeclared_candidate_models.would_be_weakened_by: little reproducible SVD differentiation among visitor groups together with near-equivalence of visit-rate and effective-service rankings

predeclared_candidate_models.question: Can reproductive performance remain high under low effective service without high autonomous assurance?
expected_signature: low autonomous_ratio or high direct dependency
predeclared_candidate_models.interpretation_if_seen: classify only as non-assurance buffering candidate; do not assign resource compensation, service redundancy or another hidden mechanism without a direct measurement
predeclared_candidate_models.would_be_weakened_by: all buffered units being adequately explained by high autonomous_ratio

predeclared_candidate_models.question: Does strict FDQ provide upstream functional-environment information without being substituted for direct pollinator service?
expected_signature: FDQ is reported only for complete taxon-plus-trait exposure units
FDQ may differ without a predetermined universal sign for open_ratio
a reproduction claim requires the service/dependency channels rather than FDQ alone
predeclared_candidate_models.would_be_invalidated_by_analysis_error: dropping unresolved or missing-trait visitors and renormalizing FDQ, or relabelling zero visits as FDQ=0

predeclared_interpretation_table.observed_pattern_after_future_admission: low effective service + low open_ratio + high direct dependency
predeclared_interpretation_table.forbidden_overclaim: does not identify historical Bombus loss or selection

predeclared_interpretation_table.observed_pattern_after_future_admission: low effective service + maintained open_ratio + high autonomous_ratio / low direct dependency
predeclared_interpretation_table.forbidden_overclaim: does not establish that assurance is the universal island buffer

predeclared_interpretation_table.observed_pattern_after_future_admission: low effective service + maintained open_ratio + low autonomous_ratio / high direct dependency
predeclared_interpretation_table.forbidden_overclaim: do not label the missing mechanism resource compensation, redundancy or establishment filtering without direct evidence

predeclared_interpretation_table.observed_pattern_after_future_admission: similar visit rate but divergent rate-weighted effective service due SVD differences
predeclared_interpretation_table.forbidden_overclaim: visitor identity alone is not effectiveness

predeclared_interpretation_table.observed_pattern_after_future_admission: FDQ differs but effective service and reproductive ratios do not
predeclared_interpretation_table.forbidden_overclaim: do not call FDQ irrelevant; the observed propagation step is simply not established

ordinary_pilot_may_do: estimate between-plant SVD and treatment dispersion
identify which candidate models are empirically distinguishable with the collected channels
ordinary_pilot_may_not_do: lock a universal sample size before dispersion
declare a causal mechanism from two plants
estimate final dependency reliability from biological repeats
select thresholds or models because they reproduce the historical Izu pattern
fit a cross-lineage dependency x FDQ effect from Campanula alone
pilot_vs_confirmatory_boundary.why: The existing readiness contract requires pilot between-plant dispersion before biologically meaningful precision thresholds and confirmatory replication are locked.

anti_leakage_rules: Do not tune any model or threshold to the historical 8/8 matching decline or 4/4 pollen split.
Do not choose a preferred FDQ direction after seeing field reproduction.
Do not collapse visitor occurrence, visit rate, SVD, FDQ and reproductive dependency into one latent score.
Do not replace missing direct dependency with floral syndrome or corolla morphology.
Do not relabel pilot biological dispersion as final predictor reliability.
A scientific null/adverse result remains an admissible outcome and does not trigger mechanism rescue.
next_gate: collect the first real linked Issue #91 Campanula bundle, run the existing preflight/structural audits, estimate plant-level dispersion, and only then lock precision thresholds for a confirmatory discrimination among the frozen candidate models
claim_boundary: These are prospective qualitative mechanism signatures using existing estimands, not fitted predictions or evidence that one candidate model is true. The freeze prevents post-hoc mechanism assignment after field outcomes are observed.
